Day la gia tri KHOI PHUC MUC v6 chu khong phai so da duoc thiet ke: v6 co gather_yield = 3; voi find_chance 0.80 va khung dam bao thi 0.8*3 + 0.2*3 = 3.0, ngang bang v6 chinh xac. Voi nutrition = 1 thi moi nguoi chi mang ve 1.0, ca bo toc phai di hai luom tu luot 1 va van chet quanh luot 19. discover_weight = 0 nghia la biet san tu dau van. dry_multiplier nhan vao find_chance trong pha Kho. | guaranteed_total_speed (E2 cua Khoa 2026-11-09): TONG nhanh nhen cua ca nhom duoc cu di; dat nguong thi CHAC CHAN tim thay loai do it nhat mot lan. Loai cang hiem nguong cang cao. O dung thuc an nang cap se HA cac nguong nay (D3/E2). Cac so la [DE XUAT]. | 2026-11-09 VONG CHINH CAN BANG (Khoa uy quyen): moi find_chance nhan 0.80. Ly do va phep do o docs/balance-log.md muc 7. Thu tu do hiem giua cac loai GIU NGUYEN - chi ca vung ngheo di dong deu.
